name: 晴海·角色写真 / Azure Summer Character Photography

source_summary.provenance: Directly observed from eight user-supplied 2:3 character reference images on 2026-09-07. Source pixels, private paths, identities and in-image brand copy are excluded from distribution. Observations and lighting branches: references/azure-summer-style.md.

visual_rules.medium_behavior: Photographic summer character editorial with tangible styled hair, tailored clothing, natural skin and an airy inhabited location; stylized character design is rendered through physical materials rather than illustration.
palette_logic: Pale sky blue, sea cyan and ivory carry the broad light field; navy or charcoal provides small structural contrast.
Skin retains a gentle peach-pink warmth independent of blue surroundings; a target character may own a limited lilac, turquoise or red accent.
Select a scene-motivated daylight, canopy shade or amber sunset branch; sunset warms the backlight and reflections without making skin uniformly orange.
visual_rules.shape_line_language: Readable hair masses with fine flyaways, controlled clothing folds, ribbons or fastenings with visible attachment, and layered foreground/midground/background silhouettes.
texture_material_logic: Distinguish airy fabric, smoother coated outerwear, ribbons, hair, glass and water; assign each material its own local highlight behavior.
Skin remains softly modeled with fine texture; brow, lash line and lip edges carry character makeup without turning the face into a plastic doll.
Fine backlit hair strands and limited bright water reflections contrast with calmer cheeks and fabric fields.
visual_rules.lighting_logic: Bright sky or sea backlight with soft open-shade fill keeps faces readable; a canopy may soften the face while the sunlit environment stays bright. Warm low sun is a separate option. Specular sparkle belongs to water, glass or specific fastenings.
composition_logic: Select a camera relationship from the event: three-quarter turn, eye-level interaction, restrained low-angle view, or a wider environmental view.
A soft near edge such as canopy, railing or an offered object creates depth without masking the key action.
For wider or grand settings, keep people at believable scale and retain clear architectural planes rather than enlarging a portrait to fill the frame.
visual_rules.optics_rendering_logic: Airy highlight rolloff, moderate local contrast, selective focus and optical depth; soft background reflections coexist with readable eyes and garment seams. Flare may occur only with a motivated bright source.

inferred_traits: Apparent character likeness is supported by styled hair and makeup within a photographic setting; the actual capture or generation method is unknown.
Foreground framing and toward-camera gestures suggest companionship or a casual shared summer outing.
unknowns: Original artist, model, camera/lens, processing pipeline and actual identities or ages of depicted people.
Prompts and whether source photographs were retouched or synthesized.
transfer_rules: Transfer light, palette ownership, tactile styling and camera relationship to original subjects and settings; preserve target identity, clothing coverage, age and culture.
Select one lighting branch per frame; change aspect ratio by restaging subject, horizon and near-depth layers rather than stretching or mechanically cropping.

When combining with another style, explicitly assign ownership: this capsule may own daylight/color/material and the other reference may own architecture or staging. Choose one authority for any conflicting field.
Make pose and gaze respond to the target event; use a direct look or playful gesture only when that relationship is wanted.
forbidden_transfer: Source faces, exact hair silhouettes, costumes, character emblems, labels, names or background copy.
Automatic halos, animal ears, weapons, swimwear, cups, badges, or branded signs.
Universal silver hair, young-looking faces, blue recoloring of skin, or all-over glossy fabric.

prompts: A grand summer fantasy film frame blending monumental inhabited architectural depth with airy blue-white character photography. Two original adult weather researchers discover the first floating island visible beyond their observatory. The new summer style owns lighting and color, architectural grandeur owns scale only.
An original 34-year-old adult male festival musician reaches for his companion’s hand as the last ferry bell calls. Warm sunset branch of airy summer character photography, intimate narrative image.

A fresh adult summer fashion portrait in the Azure Summer style, with explicitly defined natural body proportions and a gently sensual fitted outfit. An original 30-year-old woman turns back to smile at her companion as she waits on the harbor steps.
validation.notes: Primary and independent review completed on 2026-09-07. Three cross-subject/scenario examples support adoption with recorded limitations; four format/branch images and two body follow-ups were inspected. Generated pixels are local-only, not distributed. User authorized durable integration and release. No source identity, exact geometry, model fine-tuning, A/B causal or stable acceptance-rate claim.

evidence.review: Blue-white summer treatment transferred to inhabited fantasy architecture; observer gaze and pointing link to floating island. Limitation: People occupy more foreground area than requested; not literal small-figure architecture framing. Camera reads closer to eye-level balcony than requested high-oblique view.

Warm hair/water light, cooler environment, held case and companion hand interaction transfer to a different adult subject. Limitation: Skin becomes quite amber; hand pose is foreshortened and case silhouette only partially visible.

Natural bust-to-waist and hip contour, supported dress, mild neckline and summer styling are visible; original adult character and ordinary fashion coverage. Limitation: Body proportions are a visual approximation; this is not source identity/body reconstruction or a guarantee for future calls.
